newsitem.title: CHINA: Everbright Int'l says in acquisition talk.
newsitem.headline: Everbright Int'l says in acquisition talk.

text.p: China Everbright International Ltd is considering acquiring a 25 percent stake in Hong Kong Shanghai Development Co Ltd, the company said on Friday.

"The company is now studying the possibility and suitability of acquiring from its holding company, China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd (CEH), a 25 percent interest in the issued share capital of Hong Kong Shanghai Development Co Ltd," the company said in an announcement released through the Hong Kong stock exchange.
Hong Kong Shanghai Development is involved in the development of Kerry Everbright City, the statement said.
It gave no other details on Kerry Everbright City.
Local newspapers have said the development in Shanghai includes an all-night market.
Discussions were still at a preliminary stage, China Everbright International said.
The company was not in discussion with any party and was not aware of any transaction regarding the acquisition of a stake in a power plant in the Pudong district of Shanghai, the statement said.
China Everbright International shares were up HK$0.325 at HK$4.575 in mid-afternoon.
